data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (arXiv advanced search by topic, category and year, then the first result, then the Semantic Scholar citation count, then a note in the same format) with the correct parameters. It differs in minor ways: it reads the first author from Semantic Scholar instead of the arXiv result, it adds cookie handling, and it omits the "New note" click, Enter, and closing the Semantic Scholar tab. It is concrete enough to automate, though the Title field choice and the missing note-creation details are slight risks.
